name: Kairi Fujisaki
source:
Kairi has an air of superiority about her because of her wealthy upbringing and high intellect gained through a rigorous private education program.

She is quick to take charge.

Cleanliness and organization seem to be important to her, but...

Kairi carries a pink pencil case that she calls Cynthia with her at all times.

[From the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mrtired/undead-darlings-a-visual-novel-rpg-for-pc-and-ps4]Kickstarter[/url] page]
